question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating on that presence in every place?
premises: Meditation is performed in place after place
That presence is the object of meditation
Its range extends from Śiva down to Avīci
inference: One should meditate on that presence in every place as pervading all levels from Śiva to Avīci.
